gpui: Verified cells require no blockers and projection-specific implementation receipts with matching accepted revision and actual GPUI production paths; test-only or prototype-only paths are insufficient.

tests.additionalBlockerRefreshControl: A known unresolved blocker survives source refresh while fresh acceptance evidence remains withheld.
